name: Mist Trail Jacket
description: A light waterproof shell for wet ridgelines. Sealed seams keep trail spray out without much bulk.

name: Cedar Rain Shell
description: A waterproof hiking shell with a quiet face fabric. Cut long enough to cover a hipbelt.

name: Brook Packable Shell
description: A stowable waterproof layer for sudden showers. Stuff-sack pocket clips to a pack strap.

name: Summit Storm Parka
description: A waterproof insulated parka for alpine camps. Storm flap and hood brim handle driven snow.

name: Pine Fleece Jacket
description: A midweight fleece for cool evenings at camp. Full zip so it ventilates on the climb.

name: Granite Insulated Jacket
description: Synthetic insulation that stays lofted when damp. A reliable belay and trailhead layer.

name: Dusk Wind Shell
description: An ultralight wind shirt for exposed ridges. Medium is currently sold out.

name: Ember Down Jacket
description: 800-fill down in a tight baffle pattern. Packs small for cold nights above treeline.

name: Quarry Softshell
description: A stretch softshell for cool, dry days. Elbow articulation stays put on a high step.

name: Frost Liner Jacket
description: A grid-fleece liner that wicks under a shell. Quarter zip dumps heat on the uphill.

name: Fog Anorak Jacket
description: A pullover anorak with a deep kangaroo pocket. Weatherproof face for windy lakeshores.

name: Ridge Hiker Boots
description: Leather hikers with a firm shank for rocky miles. A weekend boot that can take a full pack.

name: River Trail Boots
description: Waterproof trail boots with a flexible midsole. Fast on mixed dirt and wet boardwalks.

name: Alpine Winter Boots
description: Insulated waterproof boots for frozen approaches. High cuff keeps spindrift off your socks.

name: Camp Chukka Boots
description: Suede chukkas for town days between trips. Cushioned footbed, no trail hardware.

name: North Camp Boots
description: Waterproof camp boots with a warm lining. Easy on after a wet day in the trees.

name: Merino Crew Socks
description: Merino crew socks that resist odor on multi-day trips. Cushioned sole, smooth toe seam.

name: Trail Ankle Socks
description: Low ankle socks for warm trail days. Light cushion under the ball of the foot.

name: Alpine Wool Socks
description: Heavy wool socks for cold camps. Dense knit around the shin stays up in a winter boot.

name: Cushion Hike Socks
description: Extra cushion under heel and forefoot. A workhorse sock for long dirt miles.

name: Lightweight Liner Socks
description: Thin liners that sit under a wool sock. Helps cut blisters on hot descents.

name: Peak Compression Socks
description: Graduated compression for the drive home. Firm knit, not a hiking cushion sock.

name: Summit Ski Socks
description: Over-the-calf wool ski socks with a shin pad. Warm in a stiff boot without bulk.

name: Cedar Flannel Shirt
description: A brushed flannel for cool mornings. Chest pockets big enough for a map folded small.

name: Sun Trail Shirt
description: A long-sleeve sun shirt with UPF fabric. Vents at the side seam dump heat on climbs.

name: Merino Base Shirt
description: A merino short-sleeve base layer. Stays comfortable after a long day in a pack harness.

name: Camp Henley Shirt
description: A three-button henley for camp and travel days. Midweight knit that layers under a fleece.

name: Granite Work Shirt
description: A tough canvas shirt for chopping wood and loading the car. Double-needle seams throughout.

name: River Tee Shirt
description: A heavy cotton tee with a quiet Northline mark. Everyday shirt that still feels like camp.

name: Dusk Polo Shirt
description: A knit polo that packs flat for travel. Breathable enough for a warm trailhead afternoon.
